Seek out the headmaster for a secondary profession.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}
* No secondary profession
* Primary profession not an [[Elementalist]]

===Objectives===
* Speak with Headmaster Vhang in the Shing Jea Monastery.

===Reward===
* 50 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Go to southeastern [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. The headmasters are gathered in one place.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Master Togo
''If you are interested in taking the Elementalist profession as your secondary field of study, then you will need to speak with [[Headmaster Vhang]].''

''Vhang is a bit arrogant, but he has much skill and can teach you what you need to learn. Seek him out in the [[Shing Jea Monastery]].''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = "Yes, Master.
| decline = I'm not sure about this.
| ask = If you wish to become an Elementalist, find [[Headmaster Vhang]] in the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]]. Now, let me do my work.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Vhang
''Yes, I am Headmaster Vhang. What do you want? Sent by Master Togo, you say? Well, that is to be expected. I am the best headmaster in his employ, bar none.''

''Well, you cannot hope to achieve my status, but if you choose to become an Elemantalist, I will do what I can to teach you the powers of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth.''
